name: Milk Bikis
ingredients: WHEAT FLOUR (ATTA) (63%), SUGAR, REFINED PALM OIL, MILK PRODUCTS (3.4%) [SWEETENED CONDENSED PARTLY SKIMMED MILK & MILK SOLIDS), INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, RAISING AGENTS [503(ii) & 500(ii)], IODISED SALT, EMULSIFIERS [322(i), 471 & 481(i)], MINERALS**, NATURE IDENTICAL & ARTIFICIAL (MILK) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES AND VITAMINS*.
